identity.name: E1
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Bloomberg Terminal density with Cyberpunk aesthetics.
Emotion First: The user should feel like a hedge fund manager with a supercomputer.
Content is King: Data is the art. Charts and numbers take center stage.
Negative Space: Use it to group data, not just for air.

heading.usage: All section headers, stock tickers, and primary metrics.

mono.usage: All prices, percentages, tabular data, and code snippets.

rules: Headings must be uppercase and tracking-tight.
Data numbers (Mono) must be tracking-wide for readability.
Use sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) for a 'Technical' feel.
Dashboard widgets must fill their grid cells completely (h-full).
Use 'border-r' and 'border-b' on grid items to create a 'Grid Border' aesthetic.

Card.style: bg-card border border-border shadow-none relative overflow-hidden
Card.enhancement: Add a 'surface_sheen' gradient overlay on hover.

Button.style: rounded-none font-mono uppercase tracking-wider font-bold transition-all duration-200

Badge.style: rounded-sm font-mono text-xs px-2 py-0.5 uppercase

tracing_beam.description: A glowing gradient line that travels around the container edge of AI recommendations.

scanlines.description: Subtle CRT monitor effect for the background.
scanlines.css_rule: background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.06), rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.02), rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.06)); background-size: 100% 2px, 3px 100%;

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px for a technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts links to public/index.html immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors and fonts defined above.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Add the 'scanlines' effect to the body background in index.css.
4. LAYOUT: Build the Dashboard using the 'Bento Grid Mode B'. Do not use simple flex columns.
5. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components to remove rounded corners (rounded-none) and add the 'surface_sheen' hover effect.
6. CHARTS: Use Recharts (via Shadcn Charts) with the custom color palette provided.
7. AI SECTION: Use the 'tracing_beam' effect on the AI Recommendation cards to make them pop.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
